_meta.name: English
_meta.note: PXCS user interface text. Key names are stable; to add a language, copy this file and translate it.

cli.description: PXCS {version} — lossless/near-lossless archive format for sets of similar images (with volumes and encryption)
cli.epilog: Example: pxcs create -i images -o set.pxcs --volumes --volume-size 4G; pxcs extract set.pxcs -o out
cli.archive_help: .pxcs file or any one volume (e.g. a.pxcs.002)
cli.output_help: Output .pxcs path; with volumes enabled this creates <output>.001, <output>.002 …
cli.algorithm_help: auto=pixel delta for lossless formats; JPEG/WebP same-size groups keep the original keyframe, close frames use pixel delta; pixel=all pixels; passthrough=all raw streams
cli.group_mode_help: Grouping mode: resolution=one key per resolution (default); regex=filename regex + resolution; natural=natural-order similarity search
cli.group_regex_help: Grouping regex for regex mode (default \d+_p, e.g. 1234_p0/1234_p2)
cli.group_fallback_help: When the regex matches nothing: resolution=fall back to resolution (default); singleton=one per image; error=fail
cli.delta_quant_help: Lossy delta quantization step for JPEG/WebP; 0=pixel-lossless (default 12)
cli.delta_quant_max_help: Maximum quantization step tried while the residual is still larger than the source file (default 16)
cli.residual_min_zero_help: Fall back to raw when the zero-delta fraction of the quantized residual is below this value (default 0.40)
cli.residual_codec_help: Delta coding: auto=zlib for quantized residuals (fast), PXC for lossless; pxc=smaller but slower
cli.fast_help: Favor speed: lossless residuals use zlib (about 10x faster than PXC tiles, about 15%% larger)
cli.no_cluster_help: No similarity subdivision: delta the whole group against the first image only (legacy lossy-group behavior)
cli.parallel_groups_help: Number of image groups processed concurrently; 0=match worker count (default), >0 never exceeds worker count
cli.show_groups_help: Print the number of images in each resolution/regex group
cli.keyframe_help: Maximum consecutive delta depth; 0=never force a keyframe (default 16)
cli.reference_help: Reference image strategy (default auto=chain + first image + thumbnail candidates)
cli.search_help: How many thumbnails auto mode looks back at most (default 24, 0=none)
cli.keyframe_codec_help: Keyframe coding: auto=WebP for RGB/RGBA, PXC otherwise; pxc=custom tiles; webp=WebP lossless
cli.progress_help: Show/hide the compression progress block (shown by default)
cli.details_help: Scroll the latest N [KEY]/[DELT]/[RAW] details below the progress block
cli.detail_lines_help: How many detail lines to keep (default from config/config.json)
cli.extract_output_help: Output directory (defaults to a directory named after the archive)
cli.extract_quality_help: JPEG/WebP restore quality 1..100 or auto(=95); default keeps raw bytes/lossless
cli.extract_lossless_help: Rebuild pixels as PNG/TIFF; lossy delta source pixels were already quantized and cannot be restored
cli.verbose_help: Show [OK]/[SKIP] per entry; only the progress bar is shown by default
cli.verify_quick_help: Only check payload CRC/SHA, without full image decoding
cli.language_help: UI language code (maps to language/<code>.json, default chinese_simp)
cli.language_missing: [WARN] Language pack {code} not found, fell back to the default language.
cli.pause_hint: Press Enter to close this window...
cli.no_args_hint: PXCS {version} — drag a .pxcs file into this window, or type a path and press Enter.
cli.password_group: Password protection (default: pass --password-file / --password-stdin / --ask-password, never on the command line)
cli.password_group_read: Password protection (encrypted archives need a passphrase; prompted automatically in interactive runs, no echo)
cli.password_file_help: Read the passphrase from a file (first line only)
cli.password_stdin_help: Read one line of passphrase from stdin
cli.ask_password_help: Prompt for a passphrase when creating (no echo, entered twice)
cli.password_stdin_unavailable: stdin is not available, cannot read passphrase
cli.password_retry: [WARN] Wrong passphrase or corrupt archive, try again ({attempts}/{maximum})
cli.volumes_help: Enable volumes (creates .001/.002/…; stays a single file when off)
cli.encrypt_names_help: Encrypt file names and directory structure; when off, the index is stored in plaintext (zlib)
cli.kdf_help: Passphrase derivation: auto=prefer Argon2id, otherwise scrypt
cli.decode_raw_help: Also fully decode raw passthrough once, to verify the image decodes and record constant alpha (slower; skipped by default, integrity is covered by byte-level SHA-256)
cli.create_verbose_help: Print the reason for every skipped file (default: first 20 listed in the summary)
cli.no_self_check_help: Skip the post-write self-check (by default the archive is reopened to confirm the index and entry count)
cli.memory_limit_help: Memory budget for concurrent tasks, e.g. 4G / 2048M; 0=auto from available physical memory (default)
cli.no_jxl_help: Do not use JPEG XL lossless repacking (about 20%% larger, but new archives stay 1.2-compatible)
